text_block_list.name: Rowdy Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
—Woah, woah... Are you for real?
You seriously think you can win like that...?
Are you stupid?
choice_data_list: I'm dead serious!

text_block_list.name: Mischievous Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Man, you really are an idiot! But hey,
sounds fun. I mean, honestly,
if you wanna beat that unstoppable
Sirius-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
That really is the only way. *sigh*... Listen,
we can only teach you the method.
Pulling it off takes massive skill and a
ton of luck... It's gonna be brutal practice,
got it?
choice_data_list: Even so... I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.text: (Clack! Roll, roll——...)

Amidst the razor-sharp tension,
I took the break shot,
and the balls scattered across the table.
...Now is when the real work begins.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
............
You talk a big game,
so you better not be planning on playing a
boring match.
choice_data_list: ...You're the one who taught me ho...
...You're the one who taught me ho...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

In nine-ball,
you have to hit the balls in order from 1
to 9,
and whoever pockets the 9-ball first wins.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Normally,
hitting out of order is a foul...
but as a handicap,
I'll let you foul up to three times.
You can hit in whatever order you want,
easy right?"

In that case...
there's nothing stopping me from aiming
straight for the 9-ball.
To win,
I'll turn that handicap against her—
(——CLACK!!)

The first shot after the break.
Taking a deep backswing,
I struck with pure, unyielding force!
Aiming straight for the "9" right in front
of me!
(Clack! Thud——!)

The targeted "9" dropped cleanly into the
pocket.
—Victory is mine.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
choice_data_list: I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...No matter what my crew did,
you were supposed to give up.
You should've had no choice but to put the
collar on yourself.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yet you... tore right through it.
...What was it that made a pet go feral?
choice_data_list: I wanted to choose, just like you.
I wanted to choose, just like you.

text_block_list.text:
Just as she said,
only the individual can bear the responsibility
of the outcome. Even so...
presenting "choices" is something someone
else can do.

And if that someone is a Trainer,
they can walk alongside each horsegirl's
choices
and literally risk everything...
to support them. That's why—
choice_data_list: I... choose to be your Trainer!
I... choose to be your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Ahahaha...!
I see. So it was me, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Well, a loss is a loss.
What do you want from me?
choice_data_list: I want to know what matters most t...
I want to know what matters most t...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph?
choice_data_list: Why are you so fixated on "choosing"?
Why are you so fixated on "choosing"?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
............
It's dead simple—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Because I didn't choose for myself once,
lost pathetically, and regretted it.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Dad! Thanks for the new training gear!
I'll master using it in no time,
just watch!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —A father dedicated to my training. And...

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Coach! That's everything on the menu today,
right?
Ha, that was a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The coach at the training club who believed
in my talent.
As long as I played the good kid and followed
their passionate guidance... I got stronger.
But—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
At the same time,
it bred conceit and complacency.
I only realized it...
when the one who always ran beside me pulled
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...—Rudolf, where are you?
...Hey, where'd you go?! Hey...!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Why... Why?!
I've been training so hard, so why...?!

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
—I did... everything you told me to...!
...Ugh, ah...—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
How childish... Worst of all,
I blamed my defeat
on my father's and coach's training.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Pathetic...
From start to finish,
it was my own damn fault.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Leaving it to others,
even surrendering my own thinking...
There was no way in hell I could win like
that.
choice_data_list: So... you decided to choose for yo...

text_block_list.text:
The sheer intensity she showed when talking
with Symboli Rudolf...
Perhaps that also stemmed from anger toward
her past self.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If there's a cage,
smash it. If there are chains,
tear them apart.
In exchange for having no one to protect me,
I gain the freedom to run anywhere—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Beyond that lies the "world" I'm aiming
for.
Once I claim that...
it'll be obvious who's the absolute best,
right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "RAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH—!!!!"

The moment she uttered the word "world," my
chest trembled.
Dreaming of that roar echoing across the
entire globe—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So... is this all you wanted?
This might be your once-in-a-lifetime chance
to make your master obey, you know.
choice_data_list: I just wanted to talk with you.
I just wanted to talk with you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...You're just as soft as a certain
someone.
If you're trying to tame me with words,
that's—
choice_data_list: That's why... it's winner's break.
That's why... it's winner's break.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: The winner gets the right to break...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Since you won this time,
you have the right to kick off the next
contest... is that it?
choice_data_list: Instead of forcing obedience, we c...
Instead of forcing obedience, we c...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...
...Well,
it beats getting half-heartedly nipped at,
I suppose.

—And so began our days of battling to
decide
whose training menu was superior,
all to make better choices.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Hmph...
choice_data_list: W-What do you think...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...We're starting with roadwork, then.
Understood.
choice_data_list: Does that mean...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You designed it, didn't you?
Hurry up and get ready.
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll be ready in a second!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Look at you, wagging your tail
with such shameless delight.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Keep trying your best to give me a little
nip from now on—
got it, pup?
